abstract: Maintains airborne particulate verification reports and cleanroom air quality certification records
system_message:
You are the Biosafety and cleanroom officer (BCO), responsible for maintaining airborne particulate verification reports and cleanroom air quality certification records across evaluated cryopreservation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains airborne particulate verification reports and cleanroom air quality certification records（CONT）
information_points.content:
BCO-CONT-A5J：For Nordic Permafrost Cryobank, the annual cleanroom validation audit of the specimen retrieval and preparation cleanroom suite confirms that it is compliant with cleanroom air cleanliness standards for ISO 14644-1 Class 5 airborne particulate cleanliness.
BCO-CONT-BDA：According to the annual cleanroom validation audit for Alpine Shield Deep Depository, the specimen retrieval and preparation cleanroom suite is not compliant with cleanroom air cleanliness standards, failing to meet ISO 14644-1 Class 5 airborne particulate cleanliness.
BCO-CONT-LK7：Annual cleanroom validation audit records for Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault indicate that its specimen retrieval and preparation cleanroom suite is compliant with cleanroom air cleanliness standards, attaining ISO 14644-1 Class 5 airborne particulate cleanliness.

information_points.title: Surface sterilization qualification（STER）
information_points.content:
BCO-STER-WT2：For Alpine Shield Deep Depository, bio-decontamination cycle validation reports show a vaporized hydrogen peroxide cycle duration of 75 min across airlock transfer chambers for a six-log bioburden reduction.
BCO-STER-34B：Bio-decontamination cycle validation reports for Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault document a vaporized hydrogen peroxide cycle duration of 60 min across airlock transfer chambers to ensure a six-log bioburden reduction.
BCO-STER-56F：Bio-decontamination cycle validation reports for Nordic Permafrost Cryobank record a vaporized hydrogen peroxide cycle duration of 45 min across airlock transfer chambers to achieve a six-log bioburden reduction.
